step1.title: Same rules for every side
step1.text: We check claims from every side with one published standard, and show all our work.

step2.title: Three models, no single owner
step2.text: AI models from different countries and perceived leanings investigate separately. When they disagree, you see it.

step3.title: Calm by design
step3.text: No endless feed, no outrage ranking, no ads. A short briefing, then you're done.

places.title: Where do you care about?
places.text: We suggested a place. Add a region or other countries, or keep it global.

topics.title: Anything you especially follow?
topics.text: Optional. Skipping keeps every topic neutral.

hook: Don't trust us? Good. Open the Trust Center, or see exactly which models checked each answer.
